candidate.definition_en: Relying on someone or something else for support or survival.
candidate.explanation_ar: معتمد على حد أو حاجة تانية، مش مستقل بنفسه.

senses.definition_en: Relying on someone or something else for financial support, aid, or survival.
senses.definition_ar: معتمد على شخص أو شيء للدعم أو المعيشة أو البقاء.
examples: Babies are dependent on their mothers.
The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.

senses.definition_en: Decided or controlled by something else; contingent.
senses.definition_ar: مشروط أو متوقف على شيء آخر.
examples: Your grade is dependent on your final exam.
Babies are dependent on their mothers.
The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
Your grade is dependent on your final exam.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Depend' 'يعتمد'.. الـ 'Dependent' هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Depend' على غيره.
